title: Rename the record-id type and columns from hash to id
outcome: ObjectHash becomes ObjectId, and every column that holds a record id is named *_id; a hash is only ever called a fingerprint.
acceptance: ObjectHash is renamed ObjectId across the crate, preserving stored record ids, canonical payloads and existing host wire spellings; the one-time pre-release graph-snapshot format-fingerprint change is explicitly accepted, documented with old-build recovery, and both live databases are converted and verified.

The cited review-command and CLI-reference terminology corrections use id for identity and fingerprint for compared content; all nine gates pass. Residual Low terminology findings may remain under Greg's explicit deferral permission, recorded in independent follow-ups w-ae42faae4774 and w-c180bcec46eb; no unresolved Medium, High or Critical review finding remains.
the 40 *_hash columns that reference objects(object_hash) are renamed *_id in the schema, with object_hash itself becoming object_id, and the change rides the parent's single conversion
